training.sampler: Identical pre-generated full-precision frame stream and identical initial theta within each pair. On applies the stored UV; Off uses uv_xform=None. No learning-rate schedule, no gradient surgery.
training.callback: Observational only: gradients requested for texture only, no parameter updates; preserve Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG states and the incoming texture gradient.

measurement.primary: Pre-sign, pre-projection feature-only task-gradient cosines under a common probe distribution. Report both cosine of pooled task gradients and mean of replicate-wise cosines; never interchange them.
measurement.conflict: At each sampled checkpoint, count cosine<0 among six train-task pairs times eight probe replicates; also report checkpoint-pooled gradients. This is sampled-checkpoint conflict frequency, not all 5000 steps.
measurement.confound_controls: Full objective gradients reported separately because the common regularizer can create apparent alignment. Projected feasible gradients and theta-bound saturation are secondary controls. Both trained arms are measured with both identity and augmented banks.
measurement.heldout: At update 0 and 5000 only, cosine of mean of four equal-weight train-task gradients with each of six held-out task gradients. No held-out frame affects training, update/checkpoint selection, or a hyperparameter.
measurement.heldout_collection: Frozen source policy and Plain cloth only; two trajectories per task, initial-state indices 0 and 1, stride 10, maximum 24 frames per trajectory; save exact frames and per-task counts. Match the existing production frame preprocessing and renderer.
measurement.legacy: Independently measure existing UV-On and UV-Off endpoints for a fast historical diagnostic; keep separate from the newly paired experiment. The quoted 0.078/0.238 results used a different task-specific UV probe and are not assumed reproducible by a new bank.

statistics.unit: Three independently initialized paired texture trainings, not six task pairs or repeated probes
statistics.primary_contrast: On-minus-Off change from initialization to final checkpoint, and final On-minus-Off difference, using the common augmented probe; identity probe is sensitivity analysis
statistics.reporting: All three pairs and both policies; no selection by favorable direction. Report mean/SD and exact seed-level sign-flip descriptive test. Three seeds have limited power; alignment alone does not establish task-invariant representations or negative transfer in closed-loop success.

resources.sharing_basis: Initial common probes measured 19.19 GiB peak allocated per model; 23,000 MiB reserves more than 3 GiB extra. Admit the second process only against live free VRAM and managed reservations.
resources.resume: Only same-arm numbered checkpoints and frozen streams; retain all prior output segments; never duplicate a live worker.

frozen_renderer_exception.scope: Existing recipe, masks, reference cache and photometry frozen. Original main-view gates repeated; existing wrist photometric gap retained for comparability.
